title: dactylorhiza cordigera var. rochelii
intro: Dactylorhiza cordigera var. rochelii, commonly known as the Rochel's marsh orchid, is a type of orchid plant native to Europe. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in respiratory issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza cordigera var. rochelii are attributed to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to relieve coughs and other respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
